ZeRO-3.reason: ZeRO-3 needs AllGather across GPUs → single GPU pointless

Single_GPU.reason: TP=1,PP=1,DP=1 → no distributed → fallback to PyTorch
Single_GPU.note: Megatron优势在多GPU分布式 → 单GPU无优势

INT4+INT8KV+GQA.reason: Decode memory-bound → INT4 weights+INT8 KV → max throughput

BF16+FlashInfer.reason: BF16 inference if memory permits → best accuracy

GRPO+LoRA+CPU_Adam.reason: GRPO no critic → saves ~50% memory vs PPO → LoRA r=16 → CPU Adam
GRPO+LoRA+CPU_Adam.note: Single GPU → no FSDP/DDP needed → simplest path

UnifiedWorkflowEngine+TinkerBackend+GRPO.reason: Tinker in-process → no Ray overhead → single GPU fastest

Not_applicable.reason: MindIE = Ascend NPU专用 → NVIDIA GPU用vLLM替代

DDP+LoRA.reason: DDP on single GPU = no parallelism → just standard training

FSDP2+compile+LoRA.reason: FSDP2 per-param + compile → NVLink needed for sharding

_overall_recommendation.reason: PCIe bottleneck → avoid sharding → LoRA+CPU offload
